text:
maria.docs: Quick heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate function/tool-calling examples into a single 'call patterns' page. PR #4523. Need reviewers for JSON schema conformance, guardrail guidance, and SDK snippet parity.

tyler.runtime: Link?

maria.docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4523 — main goals: one canonical example for a tool call, explicit structured-output JSON schema, and a short parsing-fallback snippet for our SDKs. Keep examples tiny (3-5 lines) + a compact invalid-case section.

jess.sdk: I'll validate TypeScript/py SDK snippets and run the snippet linter. Any preference on how we present the fallback? small helper fn or inline example?

maria.docs: Helper fn is fine, but include an inline fallback example showing `try -> parse json -> validate schema -> fallback to plain text`. Also add a short note about optional fields and union outputs.

chris.eng: FYI I noticed one of the anchors in the doc will break link-checker (we renamed headers last week). Will patch if CI complains.

ci-bot: doc-build: failed — link-checker error at /docs/call-patterns.md#tool-output-examples (404 anchor)

chris.eng: Patch incoming, fixing header slug to `tool-output-examples`. Also removing an extra trailing slash in the example link.

jess.sdk: Lint results: two snippets flagged — missing `await` in TS example and a double-encoded JSON string in the Python sample. Pushing a tiny commit to fix.

maria.docs: Great. Can we include one short schema example that demonstrates nullable union? e.g. a tool that returns either a result object or null with a clear discriminator comment.

tyler.runtime: I'll do a schema sanity pass tonight for backwards compatibility — check for fields we historically accepted as strings but now recommend typed objects.

maria.docs: For guardrails section: add one bullet about "prefer explicit schemas over freeform text for critical ops" and a short example of using `additionalProperties: false` to catch unexpected output.

jess.sdk: Adding an SDK snippet for `parseWithSchema` and a small code example for a fallback that logs and returns a default. Example to include: ```ts
const parsed = parseWithSchema(responseText, MyToolSchema);
if (!parsed) {
  logger.warn('tool parse failed, returning fallback');
  return { ok: false, reason: responseText };
}
```

maria.docs: Perfect. Also add a one-line migration note for users still relying on the old compact envelope format — show how to map to the new schema. Keep it minimal.

chris.eng: I pushed the anchor fix and a link-cleanup commit. CI retriggered.

ci-bot: doc-build: running checks...

ci-bot: doc-build: success — 0 errors, 1 warning (long example line)

tyler.runtime: Reviewed schema changes, left two small comments inline (rename `value` -> `result` and tighten the enum).

jess.sdk: Snippet fixes pushed. Also adjusted the py example to use `json.loads` once instead of twice.

maria.docs: Thanks all. Plan: merge after tyler's two comments are addressed + green CI. Anyone want to take the merge? Otherwise I'll do it tomorrow morning.

tyler.runtime: I'll tidy my comments now. Should be quick.

maria.docs: Awesome — ping me with a ✅ once merged.

jess.sdk: ✅ will re-run the snippet linter after merge to confirm deployed site examples match.

maria.docs: Closing loop: PR #4523 merged at 2912345799. Thanks y'all!
